title: Laboratory interpretation: blood count, chemistry and gases
subject: emergency
summary: Read the full blood count as one instrument, chemistry by pattern with synthetic markers, kidney injury by urine output beside creatinine, troponin as injury needing mechanism, gases in pH, primary, compensation, gap and cause order, and clotting with history and medicines. Isolated numbers never decide transfusion or surgery.

sections.title: Blood count
items: Haemoglobin, MCV and red cell numbers separate iron deficiency, thalassaemia trait and chronic disease; white cells, platelets and film complete the picture.
Macrocytosis warns of B12, folate, alcohol, thyroid and drug causes. Exclude pseudothrombocytopenia by film and repeat before alarm.

sections.title: Chemistry and gases
items: Liver enzymes by hepatocellular versus cholestatic pattern, refined by bilirubin, albumin and clotting. Kidney injury by urine output as well as creatinine.
Troponin means myocardial injury; story, ECG and trend name the mechanism. Gases: pH, primary disorder, compensation check, anion gap and cause. Compensation never overcorrects.

sections.title: Act safely
items: Prolonged clotting: repeat with platelets, medicines, liver function and bleeding history, with haematology advice where unclear.
Transfusion and surgical decisions follow the patient and cause, not one stable number alone.
